The '''Twilight Temple''' is a temple compound in [[Varlamore]]. It was initially a temple dedicated to [[Ranul]] built under the reign of [[Emperor Imafore]], which was considered blasphemous and thus was abandoned for many years until the [[Twilight Emissaries]] began using it as their base of operations.{{CiteNPC|npc=Prince Itzla Arkan|quote=The temple here was built not long before the War of Betrayal. It is said that Imafore wanted somewhere dedicated to Ranul that would rival the Teomat.{{nbsp}}[...] Anyway, the temple was considered an affront to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. After Imafore died, most people were more than happy to see it abandoned.}}

The temple is the main setting in [[The Heart of Darkness]]. The player and [[Prince Itzla Arkan|Prince Itzla]] explore the temple buildings and [[Ruins of Tapoyauik|underground]] whilst infiltrating the Twilight Emissaries to investigate them. The player must be wearing all pieces of the [[Twilight Emissary Robes]] to enter the temple during and after the quest. The robes can be reobtained from a chest on the ground floor of the [[Tower of Ascension]]. Whilst inside the temple, players who attempt to remove any part of the robes will receive the message, {{mes|You should leave your robes on while you're in the temple.}}

==Transportation==
* Use the [[Pendant of Ates]] to teleport to the [[Statue of Ates]] at the Temple
* Take the [[Quetzal Transport System]] to [[Salvager Overlook]] (must be built before it can be used) and run east

==Features==
* The main temple, which contains a [[Shrine of Twilight]] that can be used to restore [[Prayer]] points like an [[altar]]. Players may only enter the main temple building if they are wearing a full set of [[Twilight Emissary Robes]].
* The infirmary building north-east of the main temple contains an unmarked [[altar]] that can be used to restore [[Prayer]] points. 
* The [[Tower of Ascension]], a building used to test new recruits to the Emissaries. 
* The [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]], a dungeon which contains several monsters and a boss, [[Amoxliatl]]
* Several attackable NPCs including [[Emissary Acolyte]]s, [[Emissary Chosen|Emissaries Chosen]], and [[Emissary Ascended|Emissaries Ascended]]

===Basement===
The main temple has a staircase leading down to a basement, which is first accessed during [[The Final Dawn]], and requires wearing [[Twilight Emissary Robes]] to access. It contains more Emissaries which can be fought, and is where the player fights the [[Emissary Enforcer]] during the quest.

The basement contains some [[oven (Varlamore)|ovens]] which can be used for [[Cooking]], and both [[barrel (Twilight Temple)|barrels]] and [[bookcase (Twilight Temple)|bookcases]] which can be searched for a variety of items.
